map.净利 / 净资产 使用指南: Net Profit / Net Assets User Guide
map.输入净利润与平均净资产，计算净资产收益率 ROE，反映股东投入回报水平，适用于投: Enter the net profit and the average net assets to compute the return on equity (ROE), which reflects the return on shareholders' capital and suits investment analysis, management review and capital return assessment.
map.ROE = 净利润 / 平均净资产。: ROE = net profit / average net assets.
map.股东最关心的回报率指标，衡量自有资本增值效率。: The return rate shareholders care most about, measuring the efficiency of equity capital appreciation.
map.对比同业 ROE，评估管理层为股东创造价值的能力。: Compare ROE with peers to assess the management's ability to create value for shareholders.
map.结合分红与再投资政策，判断留存收益的使用效率。: Judge the efficiency of retained earnings by combining the dividend and reinvestment policy.
map.：某公司净利润 400 万元、平均净资产 2000 万元，ROE=400/200: A company with net profit 4,000,000 and average net assets of 20,000,000 has ROE=400/2000=20%, meaning shareholders earn 0.2 a year for every 1 invested.
map.由三因子求净资产收益率: Return on Equity from Three Factors
map.由流动资产与流动负债求营运资金: Working capital from the current assets and the current liabilities
map.ROE 高一定好吗？: Is a high ROE always good?
map.高 ROE 可能来自高盈利，也可能来自高杠杆（高风险）。应拆解其驱动来源，区分是: A high ROE may come from high profitability or from high leverage (high risk). Break down its source and distinguish operational excellence from a return built on debt.
map.ROE 与每股收益(EPS)的关系？: What is the relation between ROE and earnings per share (EPS)?
map.ROE=EPS÷每股净资产，同等 ROE 下净资产越小 EPS 越高；但过度依赖: ROE = EPS ÷ book value per share, so at the same ROE a smaller equity base gives a higher EPS; but leaning on debt to inflate ROE sacrifices financial safety.
